$comment: Factual, non-secret record of the upstream state this lab is pinned to. Regenerate with scripts/verify-upstream.ps1. No key material, no tokens, no private data.

release.note: The pinned commit is an untagged commit on main, ahead of the v0.1.0 tag. This baseline is NOT a released version; CHANGELOG.md still carries the corresponding entries under [Unreleased].

unreleasedAdded: Hosted no-custody MCP deployment at https://tclk.technocore.chat/mcp (Worker build; binds neither TECHNOCORE_SIGNING_KEY nor TCLK_PAYMENT_KEY and refuses to serve if either is present).
unreleasedFixed: SPEC.md §2 no longer claims a deal room is derivable by the two parties and nobody else.
examples/live-deal.mjs fails closed on venue refusals (single VenueError path, uncaughtException + unhandledRejection hooked, exit 1).
Receipt frames whose claimed outcome contradicts the contract's terminal state are rejected.

gates.$comment: Exactly the gates upstream defines in AGENTS.md and .github/workflows/ci.yml. No commands were invented; no lint/format/typecheck gate exists beyond the tsc invoked by build.

build.note: tsc -p tsconfig.json in both workspace projects.

commitMessageScan.command: ./scripts/no-agent-trailers.sh (CI job "commit messages carry no session links")
commitMessageScan.note: Upstream CI scans upstream commits. This lab applies the same rule to its own commit messages.

deviations: Upstream CI pins actions/setup-node to Node 22; this run used the locally installed Node 24.18.0. All gates passed regardless, but the Node major differs from CI.
The locally installed pnpm was 11.20.0; the upstream-declared pnpm@11.25.0 was activated through Corepack rather than substituting npm or yarn.
